Description.description: Activity to track a telephone call.

Enter the actual end date and time of the phone call. By default, it displays the date and time when the activity was completed or canceled, but can be edited to capture the actual duration of the phone call.
Enter the actual start date and time for the phone call. By default, it displays the date and time when the activity was created, but can be edited to capture the actual duration of the phone call.
This field stores the value for which attempt this outbound call is - giving an indication of how many previous attempts there have been.
This field stores a session ID for anyone that registered via the GITIS WebApp callback form. An alternate key is applied to this field to ensure that (where it is populated), it is unique.
Holds the Call Outcome code for an incoming phone call to indicate what happened on the call.
Holds the Call Outcome code for an outgoing phone call to indicate what happened on the call.
This field holds the value of the weighting calculated for an Outbound call to prioritise it in the calling queue.
Represents a Phone Call created by a Candidate requesting a callback appointment from the website
This field is used for indicating the route by which a phone call was created. Callback request phone calls are created outside of Dynamics by the website.
This is only for Data migration
This filed is to determine whether phone call is for UK or International number
This filed is to determine whether phone call is for UK or International number
Notes made after the call has ended.
This tickbox records the fact that the call agent has been through the privacy policy with the person on the phone and they have accepted that policy.
This tickbox records the fact that the call agent has been through the privacy policy with the person on the phone and they have accepted that policy.
This field holds the talking points that are expected to be covered during an outbound call by a Call Agent.
This field is used by the LogicApp for Callback requests created. It (temporarily) stores the Contact GUID so that the plugin inside Dynamics can use it to populate the 'To' field correctly.
This field stores the TPUK DDI code that is passed in by TPUK Workspace for an incoming call and stores the number that the caller has dialled to reach the call centre.
This is to store outcome codes from TPUK database
This field stores the TPUK UCID code that is passed in by TPUK Workspace for an incoming call and stores the primary key of the call in all TPUK databases to allow future tracking of this particular
Direction code for the phone call; incoming or outgoing.
